name: Tydora

one_liner.zh: Tydora 附带一个尚未注册能力的 DSH 插件骨架。
one_liner.en: Tydora includes a DSH plugin scaffold that registers no capabilities.

skipped: remaining application source files under app/tydora-web/src/ and app/tydora-desktop/src/

readme_mismatch: README describes the standalone Markdown editor, graph, canvas, mind-map, and publishing features; those are application features, while the DSH plugin entry itself registers no tools, commands, or services.

completeness.reason: The DSH entry is a loadable scaffold and its apply function registers no capability.

code.reason: The small entry is typed and clear, but contains only a name and an empty apply hook.

docs.reason: README explains the standalone app, installation, and source setup, but not DSH plugin behavior.

maintenance.reason: The repository has 350 commits and was pushed within 30 days of this snapshot review.

tests.reason: The repository contains eight test files and CI workflows; these cover the application, not the empty DSH hook.

quality.notes: The main repository is a substantial desktop Markdown application, but the DSH bundle currently points to a no-op plugin scaffold.
